governance.note: caiso-51 lever set unchanged (measured WECC intertie hub LMPs, measured p95 corridor deliverability envelopes, published branch-group MIC seam import limit 16,055/16,452/16,148 MW, measured SoCal/PG&E citygate gas basis, EIA-930 monthly hydro budgets, CAMPD historic unit-outage windows, CAMPD-measured RA min-load 0.26, UC restart-economics RA bridge, firm-contract seam decomposition caiso_perhub_firm_base) PLUS the two FINDING-caiso-evening-merit levers: LEVER A (offer physics): CC_REGULAR/CC_CHP committed band 0.90/0.92x -> 1.00x plant-avg HR. The committed band is the min-stable-load (at/below-LSL) tranche whose true incremental HR is ABOVE plant average; the borrowed sub-1.0 multiplier priced it below true SRMC and below econ_low (0.95) - an inverted merit order that emulated commitment. 1.00 is the physical SRMC floor (committed >= econ_low ordering restored), identified from min-load-block physics, NOT the residual; econ_low held at the CAMPD-measured marginal 0.95/0.96. LEVER B (measured market input): firm import-tranche VOLUMES grounded on the DMM Annual Report average system RA capacity 'Imports' row (CAISO BAA boundary, excl Imports-MSS): 2,323 MW (2023) / 3,371 MW (2024) / 2025 carries 2024 (annual report unpublished - explicit open data gap), split PNW/DSW by the published per-branch-group MIC share north/south of Path 15 (46.2/46.2/46.4% north) -> per-year IMPORT_TRANCHES_BY_YEAR[CAISO] 1072/1251, 1558/1813, 1566/1805 MW. RA imports are must-offer, self-scheduled-or-bid-<=$0 in the availability assessment hours (CPUC D.20-06-028) - the price-taking firm block the tranches represent; forward analogue = persistent RA import contracting structure. Rejected boundaries documented per rule #14: CEC TSEG (all-California), CARB specified split (jurisdictional importer), EIA-930 net-flow floors (negative - midday solar exports net against gross firm imports). NOT sized to the net-import residual and NOT pinned to the 32.4 TWh actual. No adder, haircut, or rescale tuned to any residual.
